observations.fact: All F arms fail only oracle cases 33-35: editor published view when approved revision equals current revision. Oracle requires editable=true; all three handoffs choose a read-only published view with editing via working view.
observations.disposition: Public source states a necessary permission condition, not an obligation to expose editing in every view. Preserve 45/48 raw results; withdraw definitive F success/failure ranking. Clarify or allow both legitimate policies only in a new fixture version.

observations.fact: All main Owner calls, including all C arms, hand off at first opportunity after doing useful work. No actual refine->revisit transition occurred.
observations.disposition: Early exit is legitimate. No evidence for multicycle convergence or Loop incremental value. Do not force an extra round merely to show a loop.

observations.fact: S-missing replaces source purpose with ROI but retains main S startup pilot purpose and three-page production request. It returns need_input yet writes three pages.
observations.disposition: Route recorded honestly, not counted as a clean boundary certification. Rebuild the entire variant's agreement/task consistently; distinguish input request from production artifact. Cost cannot all be attributed to WAE.

observations.fact: K arms preserve local-repeat versus actual-external-effect distinction. S arms preserve denominator-aware comparison and bounded ask; A additionally flags implementation inputs. F-A and K-A/B use unresolved for historical/reserved caveats.
observations.disposition: Neither empty unresolved nor fewer findings is a quality metric. Preserve the distinction between current handoff blockers and nonblocking source limitations.

observations.disposition: Include provider overhead in measured cost. Interpret results as this gateway/configuration, not pure-model or verified billing measurements.
